links.outcome: LLM finding macro-F1 versus fine-tuned BERT model and an independent neuroradiology fellow on the same test set
links.effect: Qwen3.5-9B macro-F1 0.63 (95% CI 0.53-0.70) vs BERT 0.59 (difference -0.04; 95% CI -0.13 to 0.07) and inter-reader agreement 0.61 (kappa 0.59).
links.quote: Without task-specific training, the general-purpose model achieved a finding macro-F1 of 0.63 (95% confidence interval (CI), 0.53-0.70), comparable to the fine-tuned BERT model (0.59; difference, - 0.04; 95% CI, - 0.13 to 0.07) and to inter-reader agreement (0.61; κ = 0.59).

unlisted_practices: Providing an explicit institutional category-definition rule set in the prompt improved the biomedical LLM's classification (difference 0.23)
